blocks.tamil_translation: “He who does not show love to the young, does not honour the elders, does not enjoin good and does not forbid evil is not among those who follow us.” Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: فِتْنَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَجَارِهِ تُكَفِّرُهَا الصَّلَاةُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ وَاْلاَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْيُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البخاري، باب الفتنة التي تموج كموج البحر، رقم:٧٠٩٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “For the mistakes and sins that occur in fulfilling the duties connected with a person's wife, wealth, children and neighbours, his Salah, sadaqah, enjoining good and forbidding evil, and the like, become an expiation.” Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَوْحَي اللهُ إِلَي جِبْرِيلَ ﵇ أَنِ اقْلِبْ مَدِينَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا بِأَهْلِهَا قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ فِيهِمْ عَبْدَكَ فُلَاناً لَمْ يَعْصِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ قَالَ: فَقَالَ: اِقْلِبْهَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ فَإِنَّ وَجْهَهُ لَمْ يَتَمَعَّرْ فِيَّ سَاعَةً قَطُّ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Allah Ta'ala commanded Hazrat Jibra'il (AS), “Overturn such and such a city together with its inhabitants.” Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) said, “My Lord, in this town there is also such and such a servant of Yours who has not disobeyed You even for a moment!” The Prophet ﷺ said that Allah Ta'ala said to Hazrat Jibra'il (AS), “Overturn that city with that man too, together with the people of the city!
